description: Abstract class 'AbstractDocumentifier' defining methods for converting SugarBean objects into document-friendly arrays, sanitizing phone numbers, and fixing email fields within the SuiteCRM search indexing module.

classes.name: AbstractDocumentifier
classes.description: An abstract base class for documentification of SugarBean objects, providing methods for sanitizing phone numbers, fixing email fields, and defining the documentify method to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: documentify
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a SugarBean into a document-friendly associative array.

methods.name: fixPhone
methods.description: Sanitizes all phone numbers in the provided document array.

methods.name: fixEmails
methods.description: Attempts to fill the email field in the document if it is empty, using the bean's email address.

methods.name: sanitizePhone
methods.description: Removes non-numeric characters (except '+') from a phone number string.

methods.name: getMetaData
methods.description: Returns default metadata fields always present in a bean.
